verdict.rationale: AFK's docs describe autonomous background execution — reads run automatically, tasks decompose into directed graphs with parallel/blocked steps that resume automatically, and goals like 'Get to $1m ARR' are carried forward with autonomy until human input is needed (afk-docs-6, afk-docs-7, afk-docs-8, afk-docs-13, afk-docs-14). This is all first-party vendor claim with no independent/hands-on corroboration, and write actions still require sign-off, limiting full autonomy. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of background automation actually running unattended, and detail on scheduling/triggering mechanics for automations.
